# El Momtaz Decor

> Brass lanterns, khayamiya and hand-finished décor from Alexandria. A small Alexandria workshop and shop selling a fixed list of hand-finished décor pieces, priced in US
> dollars and shipped in padded crates to Egypt, the Middle East, Europe, North America, Australia and Asia.

## Pieces and prices
- Brass lantern, small (32 cm): $68
- Brass lantern, medium (48 cm): $118
- Brass lantern, large (70 cm): $195
- Khayamiya panel, 60 × 60 cm: $145
- Khayamiya panel, 100 × 150 cm: $390
- Mosaic glass shade: $84
- Engraved copper tray, 50 cm, with stand: $132
- Embroidered cushion cover, 45 × 45 cm: $38

## Pages
- [Brass lanterns](https://elmomtaz4decor.com/brass-lanterns.html): hand piercing, three sizes, candle or a buyer-supplied plug-in fitting, finishes
- [Khayamiya panels](https://elmomtaz4decor.com/khayamiya-panels.html): appliqué method, motifs, two sizes, hanging and care
- [Trays and cushions](https://elmomtaz4decor.com/trays-and-cushions.html): engraved trays with stands, mosaic shades, embroidered covers
- [The workshop](https://elmomtaz4decor.com/the-workshop.html): who the shop is and what it will and will not do
- [Place an order](https://elmomtaz4decor.com/place-an-order.html): order form with running total; payment by e-mailed link
- [Shipping abroad](https://elmomtaz4decor.com/shipping-abroad.html) · [Returns and refunds](https://elmomtaz4decor.com/returns-and-refunds.html)

## Not offered
Interior design or room styling; fitting, hanging or installation; antiques; sizes outside the list.
